summary: Frontend-only testing of the redesigned Seller Dashboard and Order Detail pages (Swiss-brutalist restyle). All 12 requested scenarios PASSED functionally with preserved data-testids: login→dashboard, all 5 panels render (store/razorpay/products/orders/subscription), store name edit + save persists across reload, store-shop-link navigates to /demo-store, Razorpay connect flips rp-status to 'Connected ••••2345' and disconnect flips it to 'Not connected', product create (simple + with Size|priceDelta|stock option group) appears in products-table Options column, product-del removes the row, orders-filter=disputed narrows the table (3 rows vs 9 all), StatusPill badges render, order-open-{id} navigates, end-to-end order state machine works (placed → simulate-payment → paid → ship → shipped → out-for-delivery → delivered_pending_otp → confirm-delivery with correct OTP → delivered_confirmed with acceptance-window + window-countdown ticking '119m 57s'), wrong OTP surfaces detail-error 'Invalid OTP (1/5)', subscription panel shows ₹149/month and ₹999/year matching landing, sub-activate/sub-cancel toggle sub-status between active/inactive, logout-btn redirects to /login and anon /dashboard bounces to /login. Mobile (390x844) no horizontal overflow on /dashboard nor /orders/{id}. Landing + all 4 auth pages still render correctly (titles + h1s preserved).

ui_bugs.issue: On failed confirm-delivery (wrong OTP), the client only sets err and does NOT call load(), so the 'Attempts: X/5' counter and the otpLocked flag stay stale until the next successful action or a manual refresh. Error toast shows '1/5' but the counter below still reads '0/5'. Minor UX inconsistency.

issues: Still uses the old unstyled layout — out of scope for this iteration (only dashboard + order-detail were requested) but flagged since it now looks visually disconnected from the newly restyled landing, auth, dashboard, and order-detail pages. Same for /orders/track (buyer order page shown in screenshot: plain text list).

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: In OrderDetail.act(), also call load() inside the catch branch (or refetch after error) so the Attempts counter and otpLocked flag stay in sync with the backend when an OTP fails.
OUT-OF-SCOPE HEADS-UP: /demo-store (Shop.js) and the buyer order page are still unstyled — restyling those to match would complete the visual unification, but was not asked for this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.js is 534 lines and holds 5 section components (Store/Razorpay/Products/Orders/Subscription). Consider splitting into src/pages/dashboard/*.js modules for maintainability now that the file is over the 500-line comfort line.
StoreSection: onChange callback is overloaded — used both as (updated, localOnly) for local edits and as () to refetch. Consider splitting into onLocalEdit / onRefetch for clarity.
OrderDetail.act() swallows the reload on error branch (see UI bug above).

ProductsSection.parseGroups() splits options by ',' — labels containing a comma would break parsing. Documented format is 'label|delta|stock, label|delta|stock', so acceptable, but consider trimming and warning on malformed input.
RazorpaySection: msg tone is chosen by string match on 'saved' — brittle; use an explicit boolean state.

Order state read-after-write race: after clicking ship-btn the detail-status text briefly shows the previous status until load() completes. Consider optimistic update or awaiting the POST response body.
Subscription panel renders plan cards only when sub.billingConfigured is true. Verified plans show 149/999 correctly matching landing and backend .env.
seed_data_creation: Created two throwaway products on demo-store (TEST_Prod A, TEST_Prod B with a Size option group), then deleted TEST_Prod B. TEST_Prod A left in place (harmless, price ₹300). Created one buyer order (buyer_<ts>@marketo-demo.com, TEST_Prod A × 1) that walked through paid→shipped→delivered_confirmed. Razorpay was connected with a throwaway rzp_test_TESTKEY12345 / test_secret_abcdef1234 and then disconnected — store is back to Not connected as before. Subscription was toggled active then back to inactive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesigned Dashboard + OrderDetail are stable and all previously-working data-testids still resolve. StatusPill uppercases via CSS but the DOM text is lowercase with underscores replaced by spaces (e.g. 'delivered pending otp') — assert case-insensitively. Buyer OTP can be fetched with GET /api/buyer/orders/{id}?email={buyerEmail} (returns otp field). Simulate payment: POST /api/orders/{id}/simulate-payment (do NOT call from urllib — 403 via ingress; use page.request or curl with proper UA). Shop.js (/demo-store) and BuyerOrder.js remain unstyled and are the last two pages to bring into the Swiss-brutalist system.
rca of the issue: No bug reproduction needed; only a minor UX inconsistency (attempts counter stale on failed OTP) — RCA is that OrderDetail.act() calls load() only on success. Fix: run load() in a finally block OR inside the catch as well.
